ranked.title: Plan Manager authoring could return unreadable handles, non-retrievable finalized plans, duplicate finalize results, and fragile command argv context.

ranked.title: Correct Ollama host-inventory implementation plan using implementation-plan-authoring skill and register with vrooli plans
ranked.snippet: Found the exact prompt-manager skill id via prompt-manager skill list after broad search missed it, read implementation-plan-authoring, loaded conditional utils-unification and seam-discovery-and-enforcement skills, captured HEAD regression anchor, regenerated the 13-section plan, and saved it through vrooli plans add --stdin.

ranked.title: Plan Manager author finalize returned unreadable/non-retrievable duplicate plans and authoring CLI mishandled readable handles, phase reorder, and quoted argv
ranked.snippet: Added readable authoring session slug derivation/resolution; added finalize read-back verification and idempotent retry via the existing finalized PlanID; added a plans read/render seam in production; added server-side phase mutation serialization and phase-move RPC/CLI; added argv-json plus shell-compatible command parsing; compacted human finalize output and slug-first guidance; covered behavior with authoring, integration, handler, and CLI regression tests.

ranked.title: Improve Plan Manager plan quality, compact render, skill-context authoring gate, and setup-context parsing
ranked.snippet: Moved shared setup-context classification and execution-grade plan quality into planmodel; render and validation consume the same model findings; added compact render mode through proto/API/CLI; added authoring gate for skill context or NO_SKILL_CONTEXT; rebuilt UI and validated with API/CLI/proto/scenario tests.

ranked.title: implement plan-manager execution feedback guidance across rendered mirrors, authoring guidance, execution guided steps, and tests
ranked.snippet: Added default Execution Feedback guidance to rendered plan markdown, marked the section as canonical parser-consumed output, tightened authoring guidance to rely on the default log workflow while using phase notes/reminders for phase-specific capture triggers, expanded execution phase-context actions to include record/note capture, updated PLAN-MODEL docs, and added focused renderer/authoring/execution regression tests.

ranked.title: Author implementation plan for greenfield shared host inventory plus Ollama model roles, catalog, planner, and repo contract enforcement
ranked.snippet: Used plan-skill-discovery, searched prior records and curated skills, checked cli-health for host inventory/model planner/repo contract surfaces, read repo contract docs, and inspected host-probe/model-policy touchpoints across internal/resources, resources/whisper, resources/ollama, system-monitor, vrooli-autoheal, scenario-to-desktop, scenario-to-cloud, shell helpers, and scenario service manifests. Found no exact implementation-plan-authoring skill by name, so used the planning skill plus relevant traceability/control-surface/feedback/testing guidance.

ranked.title: plan-manager durable markdown mirror plan root vrooli plans inversion
ranked.snippet: Inverted root internal/app/plans so writes (add --stdin, import, archive) delegate to Plan Manager through a PlanManagerClient seam; added HTTP implementation using Plan Manager Connect JSON endpoints and optional ImportPlan title/slug overrides.
